intro: Book Inventory is an introductory task in Northshire Abbey given by Brother Paxton. Frustrated by misplaced and missing tomes, the abbey's librarian sends young adventurers to find his assistant, Daniel, and take stock of the abbey library's archives. However, Daniel's notorious habit of daydreaming about local tradeskills makes getting a straight answer far more difficult than Paxton would like.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We need to take stock of how many books are missing!
Go talk to my useless assistant, Daniel. He can do a quick inventory and let us know how serious the problem is.
He's obsessed with the various trade professions in Elwynn Forest. The boy keeps focusing on those instead of his important work helping me.
Don't let him prattle on about tradeskills, and find out what's happened to my books!
